title: Binomial expansion for commuting elements of an associative algebra
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $R$ be an associative unital $F$-algebra, not assumed commutative: an $F$-vector space with an associative $F$-bilinear multiplication and a multiplicative identity $1_R$. Let $x,y\in R$ satisfy $xy=yx$. For every integer $n\geq0$, one has $$ (x+y)^n=\sum_{j=0}^{n}x^j y^{n-j}\bigl(\tbinom nj\cdot1_R\bigr). $$ Here $\binom nj=n!/(j!(n-j)!)$ is the ordinary integer binomial coefficient, and $m\cdot1_R$ denotes the sum of $m$ copies of $1_R$, with $0\cdot1_R=0$.
